install_steps: Download the latest binary from https://github.com/javimosch/linux-use/releases/latest or build: git clone https://github.com/javimosch/linux-use && cd linux-use && ./build.sh
Build deps: sudo apt install libatspi2.0-dev libxtst-dev libx11-dev libglib2.0-dev
Enable a11y: gsettings set org.gnome.desktop.interface toolkit-accessibility true
note: Single static binary; the a11y bus setting is the only desktop requirement.
